filter: only products created on or after the given date (43 of 93). Note the created_* halves do NOT add up to the unfiltered 93 (43 + 46 = 89, re-verified in a single run): both bounds are inclusive (create_time_ge / create_time_le), so overlap could only push the sum above the total, never below. Four products match neither bound, i.e. they carry no create_time at all. The modified_* pair over the same store does add up exactly (44 + 49 = 93).

platform bug, not a client error: an unrecognized status value does not get a clean not-found response -- Returns/Export.php's status-name resolver has a variable-shadowing bug (the lookup loop variable reuses the outer $status) with no default arm in the following match(), so an unmatched value throws PHP UnhandledMatchError; the app's top-level Throwable handler (Api2cart/Controller/Api.php) converts that into a generic 9 SERVICE_INTERNAL_ERROR rather than a named 112. Verified by directly invoking Returns/Export.php::_getReturnOrderStatusByMappedStatus() with an unmatched value (throws) and tracing the app's catch(Throwable) fallback -- not a live capture. Candidate for tmp/bugReports/: fix the shadowed loop variable and add a default arm.
